notes: Add Purchase Entry: + Add & next keeps the form open (date, source, bill no kept) so several items go in one after another. Cash Invoice reader: a totals / litres line (Tot.LTR 0.750) is never taken as an item, quantities must be whole bottles, an item line whose numbers landed on the next line is joined back, more bill-number wordings (lnv No, Receipt / Voucher / Memo No), and the read text opens by itself when nothing usable was found.
